stop_rule: Stop once you can repeatably hear identical musical result with simpler session and intentional new processing options in the full context. Back off or undo if rendering can omit tails, automation, sidechains, or introduce gain changes; later layer revision becomes harder.
tradeoffs: The session is simpler, but changing one layer now requires rebuilding the print.
Rendering can omit tails, automation, sidechains, or introduce gain changes; later layer revision becomes harder.
undo: Re-enable the archived stack and discard the derivative.
what_to_listen_for: identical musical result with simpler session and intentional new processing options
